id.description: stable id, referenced by casts and by VN events (`joinScene` `name`) – `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`

name.description: display name per locale (the VN speaker plate); a persona without one uses its base's name

color.description: CSS color (VN avatar background, speaker accents); a persona inherits its base's when empty

own_toon.description: the toon this character is the protagonist of (e.g. the mouse → `yellowmouse`)

image.description: legacy single image (last fallback of every look/mood/variant; placeholder e.g. `<toon>/avatar.webp`)

looks.description: the character's looks; none = the one look `default`

persona_of.description: base character id: this character is a persona (another appearance) of it – one level only

RegistryCharacter.description: One character of the registry. Image values are CDN paths from the CDN root (`catpope/images/characters/…`).

LocaleText.description: Text per locale: `{ de: "Kostüm", en: "Costume Design" }`.

id.description: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`; `default` = no look segment in the convention path

default.description: exactly one look of a character is the default (VN refs without `look`)

CharacterLook.description: The same character in different gear (with / without helmet), each with its own mood set.

path.description: CDN path from the CDN root

CharacterArtwork.description: Character artwork that is not an expression (key visuals, turnarounds …).

label.description: appended to the name: "Cat Pope · Biker"

introduced.description: where the persona first appears (none = it has always been there)

Persona.description: What makes a registry character a persona of its base (`persona_of`).

StoryPoint.description: A point in a toon's story (a free reference for the editor and the story bible).

Affiliation.description: Membership of a character in a shared group.
